program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0))])
    (if (and (= (obj-h obj) 1) (>= (obj-size obj) 3) (= (remainder (obj-size obj) 2) 1))
        (let ((mid (quotient (+ (obj-c1 obj) (obj-c2 obj)) 2)))
          (set-cell out (obj-r1 obj) mid 2))
        out)))
